verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships a first-party writing-skills skill that 'teaches you to author and test new skills.' It lays out a TDD-style authoring process and documents where skills live (e.g. ~/.agents/skills/). A runtime probe confirms skills are plain SKILL.md folders with a `name:` frontmatter field, but that comes from reading an installed skill, not from authoring docs. missing for 10: an explicit documented SKILL.md template, documented `name`/`description` frontmatter requirements (description is never shown), independent hands-on confirmation of authoring a new skill from the guide.
